Real end-to-end CLI product surface (`harness auth sleep-wake-simulate --event <EVENT> [--expires-at-ms <MS>] [--now-ms <MS>] [--execute]`, dispatched from crates/harness/src/auth_cmd.rs AuthSubcommand::SleepWakeSimulate -> auth_cmd/sleep_wake.rs::run_sleep_wake_simulate) over harness_core::sleep_wake_auth: operator supplies a simulated host power event and optional credential-expiry snapshot; the command exercises observe_and_decide_sleep_wake_host_event_for (observation + refresh decision with near-expiry evaluation on Wake/Resume, skip for Sleep/Suspend or fresh credentials), and with --execute also runs execute_sleep_wake_refresh_decision against a real ProviderCredentialManager from the credential store (Skip decisions produce Skipped execution; Refresh decisions attempt the single-flight OAuth refresh and report Failed gracefully without a configured refresher/credential). Owner e2e tests (auth_cmd::tests via in-process harness::run): sleep event → skip decision; wake + near-expiry → refresh decision with remaining_ms; wake + fresh credentials → skip; sleep + --execute → skipped execution; wake + near-expiry + --execute → execution attempted, fails gracefully without credentials; invalid event rejected. Residual: no OS power-event source loop (run_sleep_wake_refresh_loop + open_platform_sleep_wake_event_source have no production OS adapter); no OAuth refresher in CLI context (execute reports Failed for refresh decisions); full production loop requires a host power-event bridge and a configured OAuth refresher.

Wave 5 restoration: a real Anthropic Messages transport is now implemented in crates/harness-providers/src/anthropic.rs. The transport includes: (1) build_anthropic_request — maps CompletionRequest to Anthropic Messages API JSON format (system extraction, tool_result content blocks, tool_use mapping, tool definitions); (2) parse_anthropic_sse_event/stream — parses Anthropic SSE events (message_start, content_block_start/delta/stop, message_delta, message_stop) into ProviderStreamEvent with tool-call assembly from input_json_delta fragments; (3) parse_anthropic_response — parses non-streaming responses with text and tool_use content blocks; (4) build_anthropic_headers/url — HTTP header and endpoint construction. 16 integration tests cover request mapping, SSE parsing, tool-call assembly, non-streaming response parsing, and error handling. The protocol catalog now marks anthropic_messages as Supported.
